NOTICE OF ADVERSE DETERMINATION - MEDICAL NECESSITY

This letter is to advise you that Northgate Advantage has completed review of the above referenced inpatient admission and has issued an adverse determination, medical necessity. Payment for the inpatient admission billed under DRG 195 for the dates [[ADMIT_DATE]] through [[DISCHARGE_DATE]] is denied.

Basis for Determination

The submitted medical record was evaluated against the MCG-style criteria set applicable to the admission under review. The medical record does not document clinical severity sufficient to require inpatient admission.

Criteria Not Met

PNA-01: Not met. Pneumonia severity scores indicated low risk suitable for outpatient treatment.

PNA-03: Not met. Blood pressure was stable without need for resuscitation.

No additional criteria were applied to this determination.

Claim Adjustment Information

The following codes will appear on the remittance advice associated with claim CLM58302348642:

CARC CO-50
RARC N115

Appeal Rights and Instructions

A reconsideration request may be submitted within the applicable filing window. The request must include a written clinical rationale that maps each documented finding to a numbered criterion identified in this notice. Submissions that do not correlate findings to the specific numbered criteria cited above may be returned without substantive review. Level of care denials are not eligible for provider appeal. Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]].

Supporting documentation, including the complete admission record and any physician attestation relevant to the criteria cited, should accompany the reconsideration request. Requests received after [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]] will be closed as untimely.

This determination is based solely on the clinical information made available at the time of review and on the criteria referenced in this notice. It is not a statement regarding the treating provider's clinical judgment and does not direct the care rendered to the member.

A clinical peer reviewer is available to discuss this adverse determination, medical necessity, upon request through the Utilization Management Department.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Northgate Advantage
